notes.title: Add-on done
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752517/82971c23092f286f840e1637f0a2c586edb52236.png[/img]

The update brings the promised addition between Polda 2 and 3, or How Pankrác became a private eye. The add-on can be started directly from the menu, or you can play it after the end of the main story. Have fun!
